chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated from his father from 'Abd Allah ibn al-Husayn ibn Zayd from his father from Abu 'Abd Allah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'By the One in whose Hand is my soul, if a man engages in sexual intercourse with his wife while a child is in the house, awake, seeing them and hearing their speech and their breathing, the child will not escape (from being affected), whether a boy, he becomes a fornicator, or a girl, she becomes a fornicator.' And 'Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them both), whenever he intended to engage in sexual intercourse with his wife, would close the door, lower the curtains, and send the servants out.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on privacy during marital intimacy in the presence of children?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration to highlight the psychological and spiritual impact of parental intimacy on children, linking their awareness to the potential inheritance of lustful behavior (zina). The text underscores the Prophetic tradition of modesty, exemplified by Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn’s meticulous practice of closing doors and removing servants to ensure complete privacy. This serves as a practical guideline for maintaining family sanctity and preventing the transmission of moral traits through observation.

en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Husayn ibn Zayd from his father who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘By the One in whose Hand is my soul, if a man overwhelms his wife (engages in sexual intercourse) when there is a child in the house who is awake, sees and hears them speaking and their breathing, the child will not escape, a boy or girl, their involvement in fornication.’
Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, whenever, he intended to overwhelm his wife, would close the door, pull down the curtains and send the servants out.’”
